name: TradeWinds
feature_notes: Trade Winds adds explicit per-business cloud workspaces, receipt-based interrupted-save recovery and separate unsaved draft recovery. Original device records stay intact. HouseHull remains planned; existing Admiral/PIN/session rules and Captain access are unchanged. Read TRADEWINDS_GUIDE.md for the three-device-check pilot, recovery and rollback limits. The additive backend prerequisite is already applied; do not run its SQL again.
